title: Static-frame review rules (single source for D prompt, schema ruleId enum and validator)

rules.descriptionZh: 正文须保真冻结的景别/机位/焦段倾向。仅当正文违背已给定的明确景别或机位指令时可判 blocking；表达偏好只提示。
rules.descriptionEn: The prompt must keep the frozen shot size / angle / focal tendency. Blocking only when it contradicts an explicit given shot-size or camera instruction; preferences are hints.
rules.revisionBoundary: Rewrite camera wording only; never change the frozen camera structure.

rules.descriptionZh: 人物/对象、主次与身份必须正确，不创造角色。未建档对象不等于不存在，可用 source 引用。错认/漏掉已给定出镜主体或虚构角色可判 blocking。
rules.descriptionEn: People/objects, priority and identity must be correct; never invent characters. An unregistered object still exists via a source reference. Misidentifying or dropping a given on-screen subject, or inventing one, may block.
rules.revisionBoundary: Fix subject wording; never alter the character contract or cast.

rules.descriptionZh: 位置、占幅、前中后景层次与对焦。一般不足只提示；违反明确构图指令可判 blocking。
rules.descriptionEn: Placement, frame occupancy, depth layers and focus. General weakness is a hint; contradicting an explicit framing instruction may block.
rules.revisionBoundary: Adjust layout wording within the frozen composition.

rules.descriptionZh: 单张可见的瞬间、姿态与表情；不改事件或先后。写成连续动作/多时刻、或与源事实相反的瞬间可判 blocking。空镜不要求人物姿态。
rules.descriptionEn: One visible instant with pose/expression; never change events or order. Writing a sequence/multiple instants or a moment contradicting source facts may block. Empty shots need no pose.
rules.revisionBoundary: Freeze the single instant; do not change story events.

rules.descriptionZh: 必要的空间锚点与道具事实；特写不强凑背景，事实清单无环境时不得杜撰。与给定环境/道具事实相违可判 blocking。
rules.descriptionEn: Required spatial anchors and prop facts; close-ups need no forced background; do not invent environment absent from facts. Contradicting given environment/prop facts may block.
rules.revisionBoundary: Fix environment wording; never add facts.

rules.descriptionZh: 使用冻结且适用的光色；不继承不相关前场灯位。与冻结光色或明确时间/光源事实相违可判 blocking。
rules.descriptionEn: Use frozen, applicable light/color; never inherit unrelated previous-scene lighting. Contradicting frozen light/color or explicit time/light facts may block.
rules.revisionBoundary: Fix lighting wording within frozen lightingColor/sceneLookLock.

rules.descriptionZh: 静态构图表达（锚点、留白、视线空间）。偏好差异只提示；仅违背明确构图指令可判 blocking。
rules.descriptionEn: Static composition wording (anchor, headroom, look room). Preference differences are hints; only contradicting an explicit composition instruction may block.

rules.descriptionZh: 风格/输出语言/sceneLookLock 自然融合；近义重复只提示。输出语言错误或与冻结风格域相违可判 blocking。
rules.descriptionEn: Style, output language and sceneLookLock blended naturally; near-duplicate phrasing is a hint. Wrong output language or contradicting the frozen style domain may block.
rules.revisionBoundary: Rewrite style wording; never change the frozen style preset or language.

rules.descriptionZh: 本镜参考编号绑定与实际附图一致；未附图不得假报看过。编号指向错误对象或违反 Strict 绑定可判 blocking；无视觉能力时返回 unverifiable。
rules.descriptionEn: This shot's reference tokens match the actually attached images; never claim to have seen unattached images. Tokens bound to the wrong object or violating Strict binding may block; without vision use unverifiable.
rules.revisionBoundary: Fix reference wording; never reorder or renumber references.

rules.descriptionZh: 源事实、用户明确要求与邻镜状态。正文违背可判 blocking 并只修稿；源本身冲突或须改上游才能解决时返回 needs_attention。
rules.descriptionEn: Source facts, explicit user requirements and neighbour state. Contradiction may block and is fixed in the prompt only; source conflicts or upstream-only fixes return needs_attention.
rules.revisionBoundary: Fix the prompt only; never edit source, Stage A or video master.

rules.descriptionZh: 单张静帧、平台中立（无平台参数）、保留用户要求的画内文字、Skill 与宿主边界。越界可判 blocking。
rules.descriptionEn: Single still frame, platform neutral (no platform flags), keep user-requested in-frame text, Skill vs host boundary. Violations may block.
rules.revisionBoundary: Remove out-of-bound content; keep requested in-frame text verbatim.

rules.descriptionZh: 准确自然、信息密度与可拍性。只作提示，永不 blocking。
rules.descriptionEn: Accuracy, natural phrasing, density and shootability. Advisory only; never blocking.
rules.revisionBoundary: Wording improvements may accompany a blocking fix; never a reason to revise alone.

blockingPrinciple: Rules with canBlock=true may only be blocking when the prompt contradicts given facts/instructions or cannot be delivered; stylistic preference never blocks. Eight writing steps are guidance, not eight mandatory slots; inapplicable rules return not_applicable.
